description: This PHP class provides functions to retrieve the current date and time, similar to Excel's TODAY() and NOW() functions. It uses PHP's DateTimeImmutable and helper classes to parse and format the current date/time, returning different formats or errors as needed.

classes.name: Current
classes.description: Provides static methods to retrieve current date and time information in formats compatible with Excel functions TODAY() and NOW().

methods.name: today
methods.description: Returns the current date in a format suitable for Excel's TODAY() function, using PHP's DateTimeImmutable and helper functions.

methods.name: now
methods.description: Returns the current date and time similar to Excel's NOW() function, using PHP's DateTimeImmutable and helper functions.
